#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""The manual's figures, drawn (no photographs: M-VAVE's and Felucca's are not ours to use):

  docs/img/fm1-panel.svg   the FM-1 front panel, with the firmware's real screen in it
  docs/img/fm1-keys.svg    the key bed: what the black and white keys do in X0X
  docs/img/screen-*.png    screenshots from the simulator (2x, nearest neighbour)

  tools/gen_manual_figures.py [TOUR_DIR]      (default build/scenarios/tour: run the tour first)

The panel layout follows the FM-1: two knob pairs and the octave buttons on the left, the
screen in the middle, four knobs and two rows of six buttons on the right, and the keys below:
11 black keys in groups of 3, 2, 3, 2, 1 over 16 white keys (F to G)."""
import base64
import io
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = SRC / "docs" / "img"
FONT = "'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', Arial, sans-serif"

BODY, TRAY, KEY_W, KEY_B, KNOB, BTN, LABEL = "#3a3d42", "#26282c", "#d9dadc", "#c9cacd", "#1f2124", "#2e3135", "#e8e8ea"
WHITE_N = 16
BLACK_AFTER = [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 14]          # black key k sits after white key BLACK_AFTER[k]
SHOTS = {"t01_909.png": "screen-909.png", "t04_303a.png": "screen-303.png", "t10_home.png": "screen-home.png",
         "t08_break.png": "screen-break.png", "t14_mix_pump.png": "screen-mix.png", "t15_list.png": "screen-list.png",
         "t19_ask.png": "screen-ask.png", "t02_909_readout.png": "screen-readout.png", "t06_tb3po.png": "screen-tb3po.png",
         "t12_fx.png": "screen-fx.png", "t17_global.png": "screen-global.png"}
SONG_SHOTS = {"s04_song_playing.png": "screen-song.png", "s05_motion.png": "screen-motion.png"}   # build/scenarios/song


def png_data_uri(path, scale=1):
    im = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
    if scale != 1:
        im = im.resize((im.width * scale, im.height * scale), Image.NEAREST)
    b = io.BytesIO()
    im.save(b, "PNG", optimize=True)
    return "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(b.getvalue()).decode()


def knob(x, y, r, label, what=None):
    """a knob: its name above, what it does in X0X below (the manual's map)"""
    return (f'<g><circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="{r + 5}" fill="{TRAY}"/>'
            f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="{r}" fill="{KNOB}" stroke="#44474c" stroke-width="2"/>'
            f'<line x1="{x}" y1="{y - r + 5}" x2="{x}" y2="{y - r + 15}" stroke="{LABEL}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
            f'<text x="{x}" y="{y - r - 12}" text-anchor="middle" class="lbl">{label}</text>'
            + (f'<text x="{x}" y="{y + r + 22}" text-anchor="middle" class="what">{what}</text>' if what else "") + '</g>')


def what(x, y, t):
    """what a button does, under it (one or two lines, split at |)"""
    a, _, b = t.partition("|")
    return (f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" text-anchor="middle" class="what">{a}</text>' +
            (f'<text x="{x}" y="{y + 14}" text-anchor="middle" class="what">{b}</text>' if b else ""))


def button(x, y, w, h, label, two=None):
    t = (f'<text x="{x + w / 2}" y="{y + h / 2 + 5}" text-anchor="middle" class="btn">{label}</text>' if not two else
         f'<text x="{x + w / 2}" y="{y + h / 2 - 1}" text-anchor="middle" class="btn small">{label}</text>'
         f'<text x="{x + w / 2}" y="{y + h / 2 + 12}" text-anchor="middle" class="btn small">{two}</text>')
    return f'<g><rect x="{x}" y="{y}" width="{w}" height="{h}" rx="9" fill="{BTN}" stroke="#4a4d52" stroke-width="1.5"/>{t}</g>'


def keybed(x0, y0, w, white_label=None, black_label=None, black_sub=None, white_sub=None, h=230):
    """the 16 white keys and 11 black keys as pills, optionally numbered / labelled"""
    s = [f'<rect x="{x0}" y="{y0}" width="{w}" height="{h}" rx="18" fill="{TRAY}"/>']
    pitch = (w - 24) / WHITE_N
    kw = pitch * 0.78
    for i in range(WHITE_N):
        x = x0 + 12 + i * pitch + (pitch - kw) / 2
        s.append(f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{y0 + h * 0.43:.1f}" width="{kw:.1f}" height="{h * 0.52:.1f}" rx="{kw / 2:.1f}" fill="{KEY_W}"/>')
        if white_label:
            s.append(f'<text x="{x + kw / 2:.1f}" y="{y0 + h * 0.43 + h * 0.52 * 0.55:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" class="key">{white_label(i)}</text>')
        if white_sub:
            s.append(f'<text x="{x + kw / 2:.1f}" y="{y0 + h * 0.43 + h * 0.52 * 0.78:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" class="keysub">{white_sub(i)}</text>')
    for k, a in enumerate(BLACK_AFTER):
        x = x0 + 12 + (a + 1) * pitch - kw / 2
        s.append(f'<rect x="{x:.1f}" y="{y0 + h * 0.06:.1f}" width="{kw:.1f}" height="{h * 0.33:.1f}" rx="{kw / 2:.1f}" fill="{KEY_B}"/>')
        if black_label:
            s.append(f'<text x="{x + kw / 2:.1f}" y="{y0 + h * 0.06 + h * 0.33 * 0.45:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" class="key">{black_label(k)}</text>')
        if black_sub:
            s.append(f'<text x="{x + kw / 2:.1f}" y="{y0 + h * 0.06 + h * 0.33 * 0.78:.1f}" text-anchor="middle" class="keysub">{black_sub(k)}</text>')
    return "".join(s)


STYLE = (f"<style>.lbl{{font:600 17px {FONT};fill:{LABEL};letter-spacing:.06em}}"
         f".btn{{font:600 15px {FONT};fill:{LABEL};letter-spacing:.05em}}.btn.small{{font-size:12px}}"
         f".key{{font:700 17px {FONT};fill:#2a2c30}}.keysub{{font:600 12px {FONT};fill:#4d5056}}"
         f".cap{{font:600 15px {FONT};fill:#9aa0a8;letter-spacing:.04em}}"
         f".what{{font:500 13px {FONT};fill:#f0a043}}</style>")


def panel(screen_png):
    """the FM-1's front panel, with the firmware's screen in it and, under each control, what it does in a word
    or two"""
    W, H = 1000, 720
    s = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" role="img" '
         f'aria-label="The FM-1 front panel, each control labelled with what it does">', STYLE,
         f'<rect x="4" y="4" width="{W - 8}" height="{H - 8}" rx="44" fill="{BODY}"/>',
         knob(105, 92, 24, "MASTER", "Volume"), knob(215, 92, 24, "SELECT", "Page"),
         knob(105, 210, 24, "PRESETS", "Pattern"), knob(215, 210, 24, "ALGORITHM", "Part"),
         f'<rect x="58" y="284" width="210" height="58" rx="14" fill="{TRAY}"/>',
         button(72, 294, 82, 38, "OCT-"), button(170, 294, 82, 38, "OCT+"),
         what(113, 362, "16 steps back"), what(211, 362, "16 steps fwd"),
         f'<rect x="300" y="44" width="236" height="236" rx="26" fill="#111214"/>',
         f'<image x="318" y="62" width="200" height="200" href="{png_data_uri(screen_png)}" style="image-rendering:pixelated"/>']
    for i in range(4):
        s.append(knob(610 + i * 104, 92, 22, f"KNOB{i + 1}"))
    s.append(what(766, 136, "The page's four values"))
    s.append(f'<rect x="568" y="146" width="400" height="236" rx="18" fill="{TRAY}"/>')
    # each button: what it does, in a word or two (the details: the manual's table)
    top = [("FX", "Effects"), ("SEL", "List all"), ("ENV", "Hold:|accent"), ("LFO", "Mixer"), ("EDIT", "Sound"),
           ("GLO", "Settings")]
    bot = [("HOME", "Pattern,|song"), ("SAVE", "Save,|hold: copy"), ("ARP", "TB-3PO"), ("SEQ", "Steps"),
           (("PLAY", "STOP"), "Play"), ("REC", "Record")]
    for i in range(6):
        x = 582 + i * 63
        s.append(button(x, 158, 54, 48, top[i][0]))
        if top[i][1]:
            s.append(what(x + 27, 224, top[i][1]))
        b = bot[i][0]
        s.append(button(x, 264, 54, 48, b[0], b[1]) if isinstance(b, tuple) else button(x, 264, 54, 48, b))
        if bot[i][1]:
            s.append(what(x + 27, 330, bot[i][1]))
    s.append(keybed(36, 400, W - 72, h=270))
    s.append(what(W / 2, 696, "Black keys: drum tracks, break slices, part mutes, mixer channels   ·   "
                              "White keys: steps (on HOME, patterns)"))
    s.append("</svg>")
    return "".join(s)


def keymap():
    W, H = 1000, 330
    names909 = ["BD", "SD", "LT", "MT", "HT", "RS", "CP", "CH", "OH", "CR", "RD"]
    s = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" role="img" '
         f'aria-label="The keys in X0X: black keys 1 to 11 are drum tracks or break slices, white keys 1 to 16 are steps">',
         STYLE, f'<rect x="0" y="0" width="{W}" height="{H}" rx="28" fill="{BODY}"/>',
         keybed(20, 20, W - 40, white_label=lambda i: str(i + 1), black_label=lambda k: str(k + 1),
                black_sub=lambda k: names909[k], white_sub=lambda i: "step", h=250),
         f'<text x="40" y="306" class="cap">BLACK KEYS: 909 TRACKS (808, BREAK SLICES, HOME MUTES)   ·   WHITE KEYS: STEPS (HOME: PATTERNS)</text>',
         "</svg>"]
    return "".join(s)


def main():
    tour = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else SRC / "build" / "scenarios" / "tour"
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (OUT / "fm1-panel.svg").write_text(panel(tour / "t01_909.png"))
    (OUT / "fm1-keys.svg").write_text(keymap())
    for d, shots in ((tour, SHOTS), (tour.parent / "song", SONG_SHOTS)):
        for src, dst in shots.items():
            Image.open(d / src).convert("RGB").resize((480, 480), Image.NEAREST).save(OUT / dst, optimize=True)
    print(f"figures in {OUT}: fm1-panel.svg, fm1-keys.svg, {len(SHOTS) + len(SONG_SHOTS)} screenshots")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Pad calibration wiring (BEHAVIOR.md CLP-79): the firmware text gives the mode its menu row, its keys,
knobs, pads and LCD page, and keeps the UI away meanwhile. The logic is in tests/smk_padcal_test.c."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
APP = ROOT / "firmware/src/app"
main = (APP / "main_fm1.c").read_text()
ui = (APP / "ui.c").read_text()
plat = (APP / "plat_fm1.c").read_text()
fails = 0


def check(ok, what):
    global fails
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + what)
    fails += not ok


def body(text, head):
    i = text.index(head)
    j = text.index("\n}\n", i)
    return text[i:j]


# The menu row: GLOBAL > SYSTEM > PAD COLOURS, SMK only, not in clip mode.
glob = body(ui, "static void open_global(void)")
sysi, bti = glob.index("GR_SYSTEM"), glob.index("GR_BT")
check(sysi < glob.index("ACT_PADCAL") < bti and "if (!smk_clip_mode_on())" in glob,
      "menu: PAD COLOURS is in GLOBAL > SYSTEM, not in clip mode")
check('{"PAD COLOURS", 0, 0, 0}' in ui and re.search(r"case ACT_PADCAL: \{[^}]*ui\.overlay = O_NONE;\s*smk_padcal_enter\(\);", ui),
      "menu: the row closes the list and starts the mode")
enter = body(main, "void smk_padcal_enter(void)")
check("if (clip_grid_mode)" in enter and "smk_padcal_start(&padcal, APC40_LCD565, PAD_GAMMA_LUT, PAD_GAIN_Q8, PAD_FLOOR_LEVEL)" in enter
      and "padcal_btn = fm1_in.buttons" in enter and "padcal_pads = fm1_in.pnotes" in enter,
      "enter: not in clip mode; start values from the LCD table; held buttons and pads give no edge")
# The UI gets no buttons, knobs or keys, and the LCD shows the page.
check("if (smk_padcal_on())\n        return 0u;" in body(plat, "uint32_t plat_buttons(void)"), "UI: no buttons in the mode")
check("smk_ck_knobs_owned() || smk_padcal_on()" in body(plat, "int32_t plat_enc(int role)"), "UI: no knobs in the mode")
check("smk_clip_mode_on() || smk_padcal_on()" in body(ui, "static void key_event(int k, int down)"), "UI: no keys in the mode")
dm = body(ui, "static UI_DRAW void draw_main(void)")
check(dm.index("smk_padcal_draw(240u, 2u * BAND_H)") < dm.index("smk_clip_lcd_draw(240u"), "LCD: the page draws before the clip grid")
# The frame: the mode takes the frame; the keys and knobs.
fr = body(main, "static void smk_frame(void)")
held = re.search(r"if \(ui_project_busy\(\)\) \{[^{}]*\}", fr)
check(held and held.start() < fr.index("if (padcal.on) {") and "return;" in held.group()
      and "smk_padcal_frame();" not in held.group(),
      "frame: a project hold returns before pad calibration dispatch")
normal = fr[:held.start()] + fr[held.end():] if held else fr
check(normal.index("if (padcal.on) {") < min(normal.index(call) for call in
      ("smk_arrows();", "smk_faders();", "if (clip_grid_mode)")),
      "frame: pad calibration runs before normal arrows, faders and clip mode")
pf = body(main, "static void smk_padcal_frame(void)")
check("padcal_btn & ~b & (1u << panel.btn[B_HOME] | 1u << panel.btn[B_GLO])" in pf, "keys: PATCH or GLOBE ends the mode on the release")
check("down & (1u << panel.btn[B_PLAY])" in pf and "smk_padcal_mark(&padcal)" in pf, "keys: PLAY marks ok")
check("smk_padcal_page_step(padcal.page, -1)" in pf and "smk_padcal_page_step(padcal.page, 1)" in pf
      and "B_OCTDN" in pf and "B_OCTUP" in pf, "keys: OCT- / OCT+ change the page")
check("p & ~padcal_pads & (1u << SMK_WHITE_NOTE[i])" in pf and "padcal.sel = smk_padcal_phys" in pf, "pads: a press selects the pad")
check("for (i = 0; i < NE; i++)" in pf and "else if (d && i < 3u && !padcal.orient)" in pf and "smk_padcal_turn(&padcal, (uint8_t)i, d)" in pf,
      "knobs: K2 / K3 / K4 nudge R / G / B, the other knob turns are dropped")
check("padled_set(ph, c[0] >> 1, c[1] >> 1, c[2] >> 1)" in pf and "smk_pad_grid = 1u" in pf
      and "uint8_t ph = smk_padcal_phys(padcal.tl, (uint8_t)i)" in pf,
      "pads: each pad shows its entry at half level (as a lit clip pad), on the corrected pad")
check("padled_set(ph, w, w, w)" in pf and "w = !i ? 127u : 0u" in pf and "padcal.sel = smk_padcal_phys(padcal.tl, (uint8_t)i)" in pf,
      "orientation: only reading position 0 lit white; a pad press goes through the correction")
check("if (padcal.orient)\n            padcal.orient = 0u;" in pf and "smk_padcal_orient_turn(&padcal, d)" in pf
      and "if (d && padcal.orient && !i)" in pf, "orientation: K2 moves the light, SEQ PLAY confirms (no mark)")
dr = body(main, "uint8_t smk_padcal_draw(uint32_t w, uint32_t h)")
check('cv_text(4, 70, &FONT_S, "pad 1 top-left?", C_WHITE)' in dr and "padcal.orient << 4" in dr,
      "orientation: the LCD asks 'pad 1 top-left?'")
check("cv_rect(x + 12, y + 12, 6, 6, smk_padcal_dot565(c))" in dr and "cv_rect(x + 3, y + 3, 24, 24, c)" in dr,
      "LCD: the ok dot has the contrast colour of its square as drawn (smk_padcal_dot565, boost included)")
check("APC40_LCD565[n]" in dr and "smk_padcal_is_ok(&padcal, n)" in dr and 'put_i(put_s(t, "#"), e)' in dr,
      "LCD: the target colours, the ok dots and the entry number")
check("static smk_padcal_t padcal;" in main and "settings" not in pf + enter, "RAM only: no settings byte, no flash save")
rp = body(main, "static void smk_inlog_reply(uint32_t arg)")
check("if (arg - 2u < 128u / SMK_PADCAL_CHUNK)" in rp and "padcal.rgb[(arg - 2u) * SMK_PADCAL_CHUNK]" in rp
      and "smk_inlog_w(c[i], 2u)" in rp and "smk_inlog_w(padcal.tl, 2u)" in rp and "smk_inlog_w(padcal.ok[(arg - 2u) * (SMK_PADCAL_CHUNK / 8u) + i], 2u)" in rp,
      "export: INLOG args 2-5 give 32 entries each (tests/smk_padcal_export_test.py decodes them)")
print("smk_padcal_wiring_test: " + ("ok" if not fails else f"{fails} FAIL"))
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Unit coverage for tools/merge_project_prs.py classification and order."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest


ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
    "merge_project_prs",
    ROOT / "tools" / "merge_project_prs.py",
)
assert SPEC and SPEC.loader
MOD = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
sys.modules[SPEC.name] = MOD
SPEC.loader.exec_module(MOD)


def pr(**kwargs):
    defaults = dict(
        number=1,
        title="t",
        url="https://example.test/1",
        head_ref="cursor/a",
        base_ref="main",
        head_oid="aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
        is_draft=False,
        mergeable="MERGEABLE",
        merge_state_status="CLEAN",
        review_decision="",
        auto_merge=None,
        files=["AGENTS.md"],
        check_failures=[],
    )
    defaults.update(kwargs)
    return MOD.PullRequest(**defaults)


class MergeProjectPrsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_bottom_up_orders_stack(self):
        bottom = pr(number=10, head_ref="cursor/bottom", base_ref="main")
        mid = pr(number=11, head_ref="cursor/mid", base_ref="cursor/bottom")
        top = pr(number=12, head_ref="cursor/top", base_ref="cursor/mid")
        ordered = MOD.bottom_up_order([top, mid, bottom])
        self.assertEqual([p.number for p in ordered], [10, 11, 12])

    def test_skips_nightly_base(self):
        action = MOD.classify(
            pr(head_ref="cursor/stage5", base_ref="nightly", files=["docs/x.md"]),
            proven=True,
        )
        self.assertEqual(action.decision, "skip")
        self.assertIn("stage-5", action.reason)

    def test_skips_firmware_on_main(self):
        action = MOD.classify(pr(files=["firmware/app.c", "AGENTS.md"]), proven=True)
        self.assertEqual(action.decision, "skip")
        self.assertIn("firmware/", action.reason)

    def test_unproven_skipped_even_if_mergeable(self):
        action = MOD.classify(
            pr(review_decision="REVIEW_REQUIRED", merge_state_status="BLOCKED"),
            proven=False,
        )
        self.assertEqual(action.decision, "skip")
        self.assertIn("not in proven set", action.reason)

    def test_proven_main_merges(self):
        action = MOD.classify(pr(), proven=True)
        self.assertEqual(action.decision, "merge")
        self.assertIn("pre-approved", action.reason)

    def test_armed_with_check_failures_falls_through(self):
        action = MOD.classify(
            pr(auto_merge={"enabledAt": "now"}, check_failures=["Focused SMC host tests:FAILURE"]),
            proven=True,
        )
        self.assertEqual(action.decision, "merge")
        self.assertIn("fall through", action.reason)

    def test_armed_without_failures_stays_armed(self):
        action = MOD.classify(pr(auto_merge={"enabledAt": "now"}), proven=True)
        self.assertEqual(action.decision, "armed")

    def test_conflicts_skipped(self):
        action = MOD.classify(
            pr(mergeable="CONFLICTING", merge_state_status="DIRTY"), proven=True
        )
        self.assertEqual(action.decision, "skip")
        self.assertEqual(action.reason, "real conflicts")

    def test_onetime_setup_text_says_unlock_done(self):
        self.assertIn("done", MOD.ONETIME_SETUP.lower())
        self.assertIn("do not ask the owner again", MOD.ONETIME_SETUP.lower())
        self.assertIn(str(MOD.MAIN_RULESET_ID), MOD.ONETIME_SETUP)

    def test_execute_requires_proven_set(self):
        with self.assertRaises(MOD.GhError) as ctx:
            MOD.execute("owner/repo", dry_run=True, proven_prs=set(), proven_heads=set())
        self.assertIn("pass --pr", str(ctx.exception))

    def test_execute_retargets_child_after_parent_merge(self):
        bottom = pr(
            number=10,
            head_ref="cursor/bottom",
            base_ref="main",
            head_oid="bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
        )
        top = pr(
            number=11,
            head_ref="cursor/top",
            base_ref="cursor/bottom",
            head_oid="cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc",
        )
        calls = []

        def runner(args, check=True):
            calls.append(list(args))
            if args[:2] == ["pr", "list"]:
                payload = [
                    {
                        "number": bottom.number,
                        "title": bottom.title,
                        "url": bottom.url,
                        "headRefName": bottom.head_ref,
                        "baseRefName": bottom.base_ref,
                        "headRefOid": bottom.head_oid,
                        "isDraft": False,
                        "mergeable": "MERGEABLE",
                        "mergeStateStatus": "CLEAN",
                        "reviewDecision": "",
                        "autoMergeRequest": None,
                        "statusCheckRollup": [],
                        "files": [{"path": "AGENTS.md"}],
                    },
                    {
                        "number": top.number,
                        "title": top.title,
                        "url": top.url,
                        "headRefName": top.head_ref,
                        "baseRefName": top.base_ref,
                        "headRefOid": top.head_oid,
                        "isDraft": False,
                        "mergeable": "MERGEABLE",
                        "mergeStateStatus": "CLEAN",
                        "reviewDecision": "",
                        "autoMergeRequest": None,
                        "statusCheckRollup": [],
                        "files": [{"path": "AGENTS.md"}],
                    },
                ]
                body = __import__("json").dumps(payload)
                return subprocess.CompletedProcess(args, 0, body, "")
            # merge / edit succeed
            return subprocess.CompletedProcess(args, 0, "", "")

        actions = MOD.execute(
            "owner/repo",
            dry_run=False,
            proven_prs={10, 11},
            proven_heads=set(),
            runner=runner,
        )
        decisions = [(a.number, a.decision) for a in actions]
        self.assertIn((10, "merged"), decisions)
        self.assertIn((11, "retargeted"), decisions)
        self.assertIn((11, "merged"), decisions)
        edit = [c for c in calls if c[:2] == ["pr", "edit"]]
        self.assertTrue(any("--base" in c and "main" in c for c in edit), edit)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Build/run only pure capture core tests; optional pinned target object compile.

No device, installer, raw input file or firmware linkage. All bytes synthetic.
Outputs evidence/binaries only to caller-selected temporary/private build directory.
"""
import argparse
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--target-compiler', type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    out = args.output.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = ROOT / 'tools/mboot/capture_core.c'
    test = Path(__file__).with_name('test_core.c')
    flags = ['-std=c11', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror', '-pedantic',
             '-I' + str(src.parent)]
    commands = []

    def run(command, **kw):
        command = list(map(str, command))
        commands.append(command)
        r = subprocess.run(command, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                           stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, **kw)
        print(r.stdout, end='')
        with (out / 'commands.log').open('a') as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(command) + '\n' + r.stdout + '\nexit=' + str(r.returncode) + '\n')
        r.check_returncode()
        return r.stdout

    run(['cc', *flags, '-O2', src, test, '-o', out / 'test-core'])
    normal = run([out / 'test-core'])
    run(['cc', *flags, '-g', '-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer',
         '-no-pie', src, test, '-o', out / 'test-core-sanitized'])
    sanitizer = run([out / 'test-core-sanitized'], env=dict(os.environ, ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=0'))
    run(['cc', *flags, '-shared', '-fPIC', src, '-o', out / 'core.so'])
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(str(out / 'core.so'))
    lib.mb_capture_sha256.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_void_p]
    lib.mb_capture_sha256.restype = ctypes.c_int
    rng = random.Random(0x4D424F4F54)
    lengths = list(range(257)) + [511, 512, 513, 4095, 4096, 4097, 16383, 16384, 16385, 1048576]
    for n in lengths:
        raw = rng.randbytes(n)
        data = ctypes.create_string_buffer(raw)
        digest = ctypes.create_string_buffer(32)
        if lib.mb_capture_sha256(data, n, digest) != 0 or digest.raw != hashlib.sha256(raw).digest():
            raise AssertionError('SHA256 differential mismatch at synthetic length ' + str(n))
    target = {'status': 'NOT_RUN', 'reason': 'optional compiler not selected'}
    if args.target_compiler:
        compiler = args.target_compiler.resolve()
        # Same previously qualified compiler pin; reject replacement before execution.
        pin = 'c45189ee624de0430deb0db02e6dce171fb5538e7fe323e3964dc8ac6236240f'
        if hashlib.sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != pin:
            raise ValueError('unrecognized target compiler; do not execute')
        version = run([compiler, '--version'])
        run([compiler, '-target', 'pi32v2', '-mcpu=r3', '-Oz', '-ffreestanding',
             '-fno-builtin', *flags, '-c', src, '-o', out / 'capture-core.o'])
        target = {'status': 'PASS_OBJECT_ONLY', 'compiler_sha256': pin, 'version': version,
                  'object_sha256': hashlib.sha256((out / 'capture-core.o').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    receipt = dict(scope='PLATFORM_DISABLED_PURE_CORE', host=normal.strip(),
                   sanitizer=sanitizer.strip(), sha256_differential_cases=len(lengths),
                   target=target, source_sha256={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                   for p in [src, src.with_suffix('.h'), test, Path(__file__)]},
                   limits=['No device/backend/writer or firmware linkage',
                           'Target RAM placement, stack, timing and identity/exclusion NOT_QUALIFIED',
                           'LeakSanitizer disabled in ptrace environment; no core allocations'])
    (out / 'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

/* 128 fatal-vector stubs, 6 bytes each: VEC[n] = fm1_fatal_stubs + 6*n.
 * The call leaves rets = stub + 6, so common code recovers n. */
	.section .text.fm1vec,"ax",@progbits
	.globl fm1_fatal_stubs
	.balign 2
fm1_fatal_stubs:
	.rept 128
	[--sp] = {rets}
	call fm1_fatal_common
	.endr

	.section .text.fm1vec_common,"ax",@progbits
	.globl fm1_fatal_common
fm1_fatal_common:
	trigger
	[--sp] = {sp, ssp, usp, icfg, psr, rets, retx, rete, reti}
	[--sp] = {r15-r0}
	r0 = sp				/* frame: r0..r15, reti, rete, retx, rets(stub+6), psr, icfg, usp, ssp, sp, rets(orig) */
	call fm1_fault_c
1:	goto 1b
